_doc: Site text that style.json does not hold. tags: the use filters on the gallery (id, English, Chinese); tag_of: 1-3 tags per style;
uses_cn: Chinese for each English "uses" phrase in style.json; about: one sentence on what the style looks like, per style, in both languages.
styleboard/build.py --site stops when a style has no tags, a use has no Chinese, or a style has no "about".

uses_cn.Nightlife and city-pop music videos: 夜生活与城市流行 MV
uses_cn.Magazine-style explainers on ideas and s: 杂志风的思想与社会讲解

archive-lighttable.en: Real archive objects (glass negatives, letters, telegrams, clippings) lie on a cool, backlit light table and come alive under a loupe.
archive-lighttable.zh: 玻璃底片、信件、电报、剪报等真实档案摆在冷光灯台上，放大镜一落，物件就活过来。

art-deco.en: Black lacquer, engraved gold line and airbrushed geometry: a 1930s poster that moves.
art-deco.zh: 黑漆底、雕刻般的金线和喷绘几何：一张会动的 1930 年代海报。

ascii-crt.en: Everything on screen is a real character on a monospace grid, lit by the phosphor of an old monochrome CRT.
ascii-crt.zh: 画面上的一切都是等宽网格里的真实字符，靠老式单色显像管的荧光发亮。

assembly-line-diagram.en: A process shown as a factory cut open: rooms on floors are work stations with tiny workers, and coloured pipes carry the goods from one to the next.
assembly-line-diagram.zh: 把一个过程画成剖开的工厂：每层每间是一个工位，小工人在干活，彩色管道把东西一站站送下去。

backrooms.en: Camcorder tapes recovered from empty, endless, fluorescent-lit spaces: rules instead of monsters.
backrooms.zh: 从空旷无尽、日光灯照着的空间里找回的摄像机录像带，吓人的不是怪物，是守则。

bauhaus-shapes.en: Circles, squares and triangles in flat colour on matte paper, each drawn to scale as an amount, laid out on a visible construction grid.
bauhaus-shapes.zh: 只用圆、方、三角和直线，平涂在哑光纸上；每个形状按比例代表一个数量，排在看得见的构成网格上。

blueprint.en: Engineering drawings that come alive on a sheet of cyanotype paper: white technical line work on Prussian blue, drawn in drafting order, with annotations that move.
blueprint.zh: 在蓝晒纸上活过来的工程图：普鲁士蓝底上的白色制图线，按制图顺序画出，标注会动。

brick-toy.en: Stop-motion toy-brick films shot like macro photography on a real desk: a world built from interlocking plastic bricks with round studs, animated a pose at a time.
brick-toy.zh: 在真实书桌上用微距拍的积木定格动画：带圆凸点的塑料积木拼成世界，一个姿势一个姿势地动。

briefing-board.en: One real whiteboard wall, filmed: window light on enamel, ghosts of erased marker, frame and tray.
briefing-board.zh: 实拍的一整面白板墙：窗光落在搪瓷板面上，留着没擦净的马克笔印，还有边框和笔槽。

caption-news.en: Social-video news that reads with the sound off: huge captions over real footage, slammed in a chunk at a time.
caption-news.zh: 关掉声音也能看懂的社媒新闻：大字幕压在真实素材上，一块一块砸进画面。

cel-anime-80s.en: Hand-painted cel animation from the golden age of Japanese OVAs, re-created in code: two-tone cels over airbrushed backgrounds, backlit neon, late-80s videotape on a CRT.
cel-anime-80s.zh: 重现日本 OVA 黄金年代的赛璐璐动画：双色平涂、喷绘背景、背光霓虹，像老录像带在显像管上播。

chalkboard.en: A real classroom blackboard on which chalk writes itself, stroke by stroke in true stroke order, with no hand, no chalk stick and no eraser in sight.
chalkboard.zh: 真实教室的黑板上，粉笔字按正确笔顺一笔一笔自己写出来，看不到手、粉笔和板擦。

circuit-board.en: The subject is drawn as a circuit board seen from above: copper under green solder mask, routes as traces, places as pads, whatever flows as light.
circuit-board.zh: 把题材画成俯视的电路板：绿色阻焊层下是铜，路线是走线，地点是焊盘，流动的东西是光。

city-symphony.en: A city film cut like minimalist music: time-lapse turns traffic, crowds and clouds into rivers of light, and cuts grow denser with the score.
city-symphony.zh: 像极简音乐一样剪的城市片：延时摄影把车流、人群和云变成光河，剪辑跟着配乐越来越密。

colored-pencil.en: A real 3D cutaway world redrawn every frame as a coloured-pencil plate on toothed paper, with graphite contours and pencilled paper tags.
colored-pencil.zh: 真 3D 剖面世界，每帧重画成粗纹纸上的彩铅图版：铅笔轮廓、层层排线、手写纸标签。

comic-history.en: Countries as paper puppets on a printed paper map: whoever takes land cuts a scrap and slaps it on, panel by panel across one comic page.
comic-history.zh: 国家是开口钉连着的纸偶，站在印刷纸地图上；谁占了地就剪一块纸拍上去，一格一格排在一页漫画里。

countdown.en: An edit style, not a look: real footage of one event shown in real time, the screen splitting into more cells as zero nears, then merging.
countdown.zh: 一种剪法而不是画风：真实素材按真实时间播放，越近零点分屏越多，归零时合成一个画面。

crayon-book.en: A picture-book page drawn live in wax crayon on toothy paper, with a watercolour wash that reveals what the crayon was hiding.
crayon-book.zh: 在粗纹纸上用蜡笔现场画出的绘本页，水彩一刷，蜡笔藏着的东西就显出来。

crayon-world.en: A real 3D world redrawn in a child’s wax crayon twelve times a second, with true depth and a camera moving through it on one sheet of paper.
crayon-world.zh: 真 3D 世界被孩子的蜡笔每秒重画 12 次：有真实的纵深和运镜，每一帧仍是同一张纸上的蜡笔画。

dark-documentary.en: A black world that only exists where a scan of light has passed, leaving fading echoes: contours, range rings, wireframes, and facts read off instruments.
dark-documentary.zh: 漆黑的世界，只有扫描光掠过的地方才显形，留下慢慢淡去的回波：等高线、距离环、线框，事实以仪表读数出现。

dark-keynote.en: A software launch film where the interface itself is the star: near-black gradient, hairline grid, soft light, one brand accent, and UI that moves with snap-grid precision.
dark-keynote.zh: 界面本身当主角的软件发布片：近黑渐变、极细网格、柔光、一个品牌色，元素按网格精准吸附移动。

data-physical.en: Real statistics built as real objects: every unit a countable piece (plate, block, coin, bar) stacked to exact scale and shot like a studio product.
data-physical.zh: 把真实统计数据做成实物：每个单位是一块数得清的材料，按准确比例叠起，像产品一样棚拍。

dataviz.en: A chart that tells a story: real data, drawn mark by mark on cream paper by a red–blue pencil, with handwritten notes pinned to the numbers.
dataviz.zh: 会讲故事的图表：红蓝铅笔在米色纸上一笔一笔画出真实数据，手写批注钉在数字旁边。

desktop-flythrough.en: App screens and tools lie on a sunlit desk as printed paper cards; small voxel characters carry the work card to card, chased by one unbroken camera.
desktop-flythrough.zh: 应用界面印成纸卡摊在洒满阳光的书桌上，体素小人把活儿一张张往下传，镜头一镜到底紧跟。

double-exposure.en: An animal silhouette as a window onto a second photograph, in monochrome with warm lamps, the shape and the world inside it moving at different speeds.
double-exposure.zh: 动物剪影是一扇窗，里面是另一张照片；黑白影像配暖色灯光，剪影和里面的世界以不同速度移动。

engraving.en: An intaglio plate that engraves itself: a burin cuts swelling lines into copper, a proof is pulled, and outline, hatching and cross-hatching build a finished plate.
engraving.zh: 自己刻出来的铜版画：雕刀推出粗细起伏的线，拓出样张，轮廓、排线、交叉线一层层叠成图版。

firefly-pointillism.en: Thousands of soft breathing points of light on black form every figure and word, and scatter and gather to become the next.
firefly-pointillism.zh: 黑底上成千上万个呼吸的柔光点组成人物、动物和字，散开、飞走、再聚成新的东西。

flat-space-explainer.en: Solid flat shapes with hard-ring glows on deep night blue, drawn to true scale, with a scale readout as the camera travels through orders of magnitude.
flat-space-explainer.zh: 深夜蓝底上的平涂实心形状，光晕是两圈硬边环；每帧按真实比例画，镜头穿越数量级时角落读出尺度。

flow-field.en: An invisible flow made visible as thousands of thin ink streamlines on warm paper, computed from real data and bending round coasts and mountains.
flow-field.zh: 把看不见的流动画成暖色纸上成千上万条细墨流线，由真实数据算出，绕着海岸和山脉弯转。

game-show.en: A rhythm-game variety show in flat vector: toy-like mascots with thick ink outlines on candy-coloured stripes and sunbursts, every hit locked to the beat.
game-show.zh: 扁平矢量的节奏游戏综艺：粗墨线的玩具感角色站在糖果色条纹和放射光上，每一下都卡在拍子上。

gilded-illumination.en: The whole frame is one gilded miniature: flat mineral pigments in firm ink lines, white-lead highlights, and real gold leaf that shines only when light crosses it.
gilded-illumination.zh: 整个画面是一幅泥金细密画：矿物颜料平涂、墨线勾边、铅白点高光，真金箔只在光扫过时发亮。

glass-product.en: Launch-film product rendering in transparent and frosted glass: dark-field studio, strip-light sweeps, dispersion, caustics, light travelling inside the object, slow exploded views that snap shut on a downbeat.
glass-product.zh: 透明与磨砂玻璃的产品发布片：暗场灯条扫光、色散、焦散，光在物体里走，爆炸图踩着重拍合拢。

halftone-dossier.en: A retro print case file: cream archive paper, overprinted halftone dots in a few flat inks, huge headlines with misregistered shadows, rubber stamps that slam, and thick-outlined characters.
halftone-dossier.zh: 复古印刷的案卷：米色档案纸，几色网点叠印，大标题带错位的影子，橡皮章重重盖下，角色描粗边。

hardcore-info.en: A real-sized 3D object traced live into a black-line technical drawing on warm paper, with numbered leaders and one accent colour for the one path explained.
hardcore-info.zh: 按真实尺寸建模的物件实时描成暖白纸上的黑线工程图，编号引线跟着零件走，只有讲解的那条路径用一种强调色。

hd-2d.en: Hand-made pixel sprites stand like paper cut-outs in a lit, fogged 3D diorama, shot high through a tilt-shift lens: a toy world where every lamp casts real shadows.
hd-2d.zh: 像素小人像纸片一样立在有光有雾的 3D 微缩场景里，高角度移轴拍摄，每盏灯都投下真实的影子。

hologram-hud.en: An object is scanned into a glowing wireframe; target boxes lock onto its parts and each number rolls from garbage glyphs to the real value.
hologram-hud.zh: 物体被扫描成发光线框，目标框逐个锁定部件，数字从乱码滚到真实数值。

impasto.en: Thick oil paint laid with a palette knife: big, flat, sharp-edged planes of colour, raked by light so every ridge of paint shows.
impasto.zh: 用调色刀堆上去的厚油彩：大块平整、边缘锐利的色面，侧光一照，每道颜料棱都看得见。

ink-wash.en: Xieyi ink painting on rice paper, animated: blank paper is space, one brushstroke is a mountain, a wave, a gesture or a cut.
ink-wash.zh: 动起来的宣纸写意：留白就是空间，一笔可以是山、是浪、是一个动作，也可以是一次剪辑。

instruction-manual.en: A printed assembly manual come to life: true isometric black line art, flat white parts, faceless people and the manual’s own steps, arrows and magnifiers.
instruction-manual.zh: 一份会动的组装说明书：等轴测黑线稿、白色平涂零件、无脸小人，用说明书自己的步骤号、箭头和放大圈来讲。

ipad-sketch.en: A cream drawing canvas on a tablet: grainy pencil lines first, flat colour blocks after, slightly off the line, and the canvas pinched, panned and turned between ideas.
ipad-sketch.zh: 平板上的米色画布：先下颗粒铅笔线，再铺略微错位的平涂色块，画布在想法之间缩放、平移、旋转。

iso-infographic.en: A system diagram comes alive: an isometric diorama of flat three-tone blocks, thin ink labels and Isotype numbers, where things open to show their insides.
iso-infographic.zh: 动起来的系统图：三色平涂块搭成等距模型，细墨线标注，Isotype 数字，东西能打开看内部。

isometric-picture-book.en: A calm explainer of an everyday rule, set in one real place drawn in flat-colour isometric, where small faceless people do the thing in order.
isometric-picture-book.zh: 平静地讲清一条日常规则：真实场所画成平涂等距图，没有五官的小人按顺序把事做一遍。

kino-montage.en: Real archive footage, photographs and documents, printed as one ink-and-paper poster with a single red, and cut on a machine beat.
kino-montage.zh: 真实档案影像、照片和文件印成一张只用一种红的油墨海报，踩着机器般的节拍剪辑。

lidar-survey.en: Real airborne laser points of a place float in the dark; a scan line passes through and they condense into a raking-lit surface, measured with hairline instruments.
lidar-survey.zh: 真实的机载激光点云悬在黑暗里，扫描线扫过，点凝成侧光下的实体地表，再用细线测量。

living-screencast.en: A product walkthrough that looks like a real screen recording, where a low-resolution mascot lives inside a high-resolution interface and acts out what the software is doing.
living-screencast.zh: 看起来像真实录屏的产品演示：低分辨率的吉祥物住在高清界面里，把软件正在做的事演出来。

lowpoly-island.en: A tiny faceted world seen through an orthographic isometric lens: everything is a geometric block, and everything that appears arrives with a bounce and a note.
lowpoly-island.zh: 正交等距镜头里的多面体小世界：一切都是几何块，每样东西出现时都弹一下、响一个音。

manga-panels.en: A black-and-white manga page that moves: G-pen ink, screentone dots, one spot colour, panels opening on the beat and lettered sound effects.
manga-panels.zh: 会动的黑白漫画页：G 笔墨线、网点纸、一个点缀色，分格踩着节拍打开，拟声字一个个砸进来。

map-explainer.en: Real elevation and imagery built into a 3D map lit by a low sun, with a glowing data layer of routes and measurements laid on true geography.
map-explainer.zh: 用真实高程和影像搭成 3D 地图，低角度暖阳照明，发光的数据层（航线、测量、柱子）贴着真实地理展开。

marker-paper.en: Matte white paper and a black bullet-tip marker, with red and blue for meaning only: a problem drawn and solved one sheet at a time.
marker-paper.zh: 哑光白纸加一支黑色圆头马克笔，红和蓝只用来表达含义：一张纸一个问题，一笔笔画出推理和答案。

memphis-diorama.en: A place built as a tabletop model: a small world in flat Memphis colours, ink outlines and hard purple shadows, inside a grainy frame on warm white paper.
memphis-diorama.zh: 把一个地方做成桌面模型：暖白纸上一圈颗粒画框，里面是孟菲斯平涂色、墨线、硬紫影子的小世界。

microgame.en: A rapid-fire party-game film: one command word, a few seconds, one action, each game in a different art style, faster and faster.
microgame.zh: 连珠炮式的派对小游戏片：一个口令、几秒钟、一个动作，每关换一种画风，越来越快。

microscope.en: Real microscopy of a real specimen, seen as it is, and one continuous change of scale from the glass slide in the hand to a single cell.
microscope.zh: 真实标本的显微影像，照原样呈现，一个连续变倍从手里的玻片一路推到单个细胞。

midcentury-toon.en: 1950s flat colour and limited animation for follow-along films: colour printed slightly off a broken ink line, still bodies with working hands, abstract colour-block rooms.
midcentury-toon.zh: 50 年代平涂加有限动画的跟做教学片：颜色略偏出断续墨线，身体不动只动手，房间是抽象色块。

neon-tubes.en: Real neon signs on a rainy night street: bent glass tubes on painted boards strike with a flicker, light the wet walls and double in every puddle.
neon-tubes.zh: 雨夜老街上的真霓虹招牌：弯好的玻璃灯管装在漆过的招牌板上，一闪亮起，照亮湿墙，倒映在每个水坑里。

news-package.en: A TV newsroom's on-air package built in code: a sting that becomes the channel bug, a story rundown, a lower-third strap and full-frame graphics that carry the facts.
news-package.zh: 用代码做出整套电视新闻包装：片头收成台标，串联单、标题条和整屏图表负责讲事实。

newsreel.en: A late-1920s sound newsreel cut from real archive material: searchlight-and-globe ident, spinning newspapers, a fast, cheerful announcer, title cards, wipes and a hot band.
newsreel.zh: 用真实档案剪成的 20 年代末有声新闻片：探照灯地球片头、飞转的报纸、轻快的播音和热闹的乐队。

one-bit-dither.en: A real 3D world in exactly two inks: every grey becomes dots fixed to the surfaces, and the camera moves freely without the pattern swimming.
one-bit-dither.zh: 只用两种墨的真 3D 世界：每一级灰都变成贴在表面上的点阵，镜头自由移动，点阵不会游动。

one-line.en: A single ink line that never leaves the paper.
one-line.zh: 一根从头到尾不离开纸面的墨线。

oscilloscope-math.en: Mathematics drawn by an electron beam: thin glowing green lines on a phosphor screen with a dotted graticule, every number computed from what draws the picture.
oscilloscope-math.zh: 电子束画出来的数学：荧光屏上发光的细绿线和点状刻度，屏上每个数字都由画图的同一组数值算出。

paper-lantern.en: A layered paper-cut shadow box lit from behind: 6–9 sheets of cut card in a shallow box, warm light glowing through, soft shadows between layers.
paper-lantern.zh: 背后打光的纸雕灯：浅盒里叠着六到九层镂空卡纸，暖光透出来，层与层之间落下柔和的影子。

paper-popup.en: A pop-up book on a real desk becomes a stage: white-bordered cut-paper actors perform before sets that spring from the page, under lamp light and a macro lens.
paper-popup.zh: 真实书桌上的立体书变成舞台：带白边的剪纸角色在书页弹起的纸布景前表演，台灯照着，微距拍摄。

papercut-red.en: Chinese window-flower paper-cuts brought to life: jointed red cut-outs on paper grounds, where the cut is the drawing and the holes are where the light gets in.
papercut-red.zh: 动起来的窗花剪纸：带关节的红纸人物贴在纸底上，剪痕就是线条，镂空处透进光来。

pen-plotter.en: A pen plotter on a desk draws the subject stroke by stroke with real pens and ink, with pen changes, pen-up travel and the camera beside the machine.
pen-plotter.zh: 桌上的绘图仪用真笔真墨一笔一笔画：换笔、抬笔空走、落笔出墨，镜头就在机器旁边。

pictogram-motion.en: A beat-locked flash-card film built from three things only: a sliding square-grid pattern, geometric pictograms of round-capped bars and a disc head, and bold bilingual type.
pictogram-motion.zh: 卡着鼓点的快闪片，只用三样东西：滑动的方格图案、圆头线条拼成的几何小人和粗体双语字。

pip-simulation.en: Small flocked characters run a real simulation on a paper lab board; they are the data points, and at the end they line up into the chart.
pip-simulation.zh: 一群植绒小人在纸面实验板上跑真实的模拟；它们自己就是数据点，最后排成图表。

pixel-rpg.en: A short film that looks, sounds and behaves like a mid-90s console RPG: 320×180 pixels, limited palette, typing text boxes, menus, save files, echoing chip music.
pixel-rpg.zh: 看、听、玩起来都像 90 年代中期主机 RPG：320×180 像素、逐字对话框、存档和芯片音乐。

pop-art.en: Sixties pop-art screen prints: Ben-Day dots fixed to the paper, heavy black key lines, flat primaries and plates that never quite register.
pop-art.zh: 六十年代波普丝印海报：印在纸上的本戴点、粗黑轮廓线、平涂三原色、总也套不准的色版。

precise-mechanism.en: A real mechanism in 3D coloured like an anatomy plate, one flat colour per subsystem, running at true ratios while the camera cuts it open and explodes it.
precise-mechanism.zh: 真 3D 机械按解剖图上色：每个子系统一种平涂色，按真实传动比运转，镜头把它剖开、按系统炸开。

printed-long-take.en: A three-dimensional world rendered as a scratchboard print, ink and paper with one red, crossed by one unbroken camera move.
printed-long-take.zh: 一个刮版画质感的三维世界，只有墨、纸和一种红，镜头一镜到底从中穿过。

risograph.en: Animation that looks printed frame by frame on a stencil duplicator: two or three translucent spot inks on warm paper, halftone dots, and plates that never quite align.
risograph.zh: 像用孔版印刷机逐帧印出来的动画：两三种半透明专色叠在暖色纸上，网点可见，套版总差一点。

rubber-hose.en: Black-and-white hand-inked cartoons where every object is alive and swings to a hot jazz band.
rubber-hose.zh: 黑白手工勾墨的卡通，每样东西都是活的，跟着热爵士乐队摇摆。

satellite-briefing.en: Real satellite imagery of a real place, graded to an analyst's grey, with thin white measurement lines drawn on the ground: reticle, outlines, one reading.
satellite-briefing.zh: 真实地点的卫星影像调成分析用的灰，地面上画细白测量线：瞄准框、轮廓和一个读数。

scifi-toon.en: Adult-animation sci-fi sitcom: thick boiling outlines, flat colour, a duo whose reactions don't match, a glowing portal, and one palette per world.
scifi-toon.zh: 成人科幻情景喜剧：抖动的粗轮廓、平涂色、反应对不上的二人组、发光传送门，每个世界一套配色。

scratch-film.en: Pictures scratched through black emulsion with a needle and tinted with dye, redrawn fifteen times a second so the lines boil and light glows through every cut.
scratch-film.zh: 用针在黑色乳剂上刮出画面再染色，每秒重画 15 次，线条跳动，光从每道刻痕里透出来。

security-xray.en: Seen through a baggage-screening console: dual-energy X-ray images with fixed material colours, and the operator present only as boxes and readings on screen.
security-xray.zh: 透过安检机屏幕看：双能 X 光图像按材质上色（有机物橙、金属蓝），安检员只以屏上的框和读数出现。

shadow-puppet.en: Chinese shadow theatre: translucent dyed-hide puppets, carved like lace, pressed against a cotton screen and lit from behind by oil lamps.
shadow-puppet.zh: 中国皮影戏：镂刻得像花边的半透明彩色皮影贴着棉布幕，油灯从背后照亮。

silent-film.en: An engraved-illustration silent film projected in a picture house: ink line and silver wash, a flickering 4:3 print between velvet curtains, intertitles, and a cinema pianist.
silent-film.zh: 在老影院放映的版画风默片：墨线加银灰淡彩，画面在丝绒幕间闪烁，字幕卡代替对白，钢琴伴奏。

silhouette-rhythm.en: Pure black silhouettes against a saturated sunset change pose on every beat; on the key beat all freezes but the sky, and the water doubles everything.
silhouette-rhythm.zh: 饱和夕阳前的纯黑剪影每个节拍换一个姿势；重拍时一切定住，只有天空还在动，水面映出倒影。

silkscreen-poster.en: Opaque, hard-edged flat inks pulled one colour at a time through a screen: 4–6 inks, stepped colour bands instead of gradients, thin paper-white gaps where registration slips.
silkscreen-poster.zh: 不透明的硬边平涂油墨，一次一色刮过丝网：四到六色，分级色带代替渐变，套印走位处露出纸白。

sketchnote.en: One page of visual notes on dot-grid paper drawn as you watch: black fineliner, grey marker for shadow, and one yellow for the thing that matters.
sketchnote.zh: 点阵纸上边看边画的一页视觉笔记：黑色针管笔写画，灰色马克笔做阴影，只有最重要的那件事用黄色。

spreadsheet.en: A whole film inside one spreadsheet: cells are the pixels, conditional formatting paints the pictures and the sheet’s own zoom and scroll are the camera.
spreadsheet.zh: 整支片在一个表格里：单元格是像素，条件格式画出画面，表格自己的缩放和滚动就是镜头。

spy-titles.en: A cut-paper, four-ink opening title sequence for a film that never existed: silhouettes move through sets built from the credits, and every brass stab is a cut.
spy-titles.zh: 一部不存在的电影的剪纸四色片头：剪影穿行在演职员字幕搭成的布景里，铜管每响一下就切一刀。

stained-glass.en: A medieval stained-glass window seen from inside a dark stone hall, alive only where the sun touches it: light is the clock, the camera and the story.
stained-glass.zh: 从昏暗石厅里看中世纪彩色玻璃窗，阳光照到哪里哪里才动：光就是时钟、镜头和故事。

stick-explainer.en: Plain stick people on warm paper with one accent colour; held hands are one continuous line, so a crowd joins into a line, a ring or a shape.
stick-explainer.zh: 暖色纸上的简笔小人加一种强调色；牵手是一条连续的线，所以一群人能连成一排、一个圈或一个形状。

swiss-motion.en: International Typographic Style in motion: a modular grid, one typeface, one signal colour, and movement as exact as a printing press.
swiss-motion.zh: 动起来的瑞士国际主义排版：模块网格、一种字体、一种信号色，动作像印刷机一样精准。

teardown.en: A real product rebuilt from its own engineering files, lit like a studio packshot and taken apart on camera: layers lift on one axis, every part named.
teardown.zh: 按真实产品的工程文件建模，像产品照一样打光，在镜头前沿一根轴逐层拆开，零件逐个标名。

telestrator.en: The TV football analysis segment: rewind, freeze and draw on the broadcast picture, with rings under players' feet, ball arrows and a red patch for uncovered space.
telestrator.zh: 电视足球分析环节：倒回、定格，在转播画面上给球员画圈、给球画箭头，把没人盯的空当涂红。

text-flash-cuts.en: Avant-garde TV anime: full-screen heavy Mincho title cards cut in for a few frames, symbolic geometric architecture and a red, black and white palette.
text-flash-cuts.zh: 先锋电视动画：整屏粗明朝体字卡只闪几帧，建筑简化成象征性几何，红黑白三色。

thermal-camera.en: Seen through a radiometric thermal camera: a low-resolution iron-palette picture where brightness is temperature, with the camera’s spot meters and scales on screen.
thermal-camera.zh: 透过测温热像仪看：低分辨率的铁红色调画面，亮度就是温度，屏上带着测温点、色标等仪器读数。

tilt-shift.en: A real-looking place photographed from high above with a tilted lens and a time-lapse camera, so the whole world reads as a tabletop model.
tilt-shift.zh: 从高处用移轴镜头延时拍摄一个看似真实的地方，整个世界看起来像桌上的模型。

transit-map.en: A metro schematic printed on a physical sheet: lines held to eight directions, white stops, black-outlined interchange capsules, water as a flat blue band.
transit-map.zh: 印在纸上的地铁线路图：线路只走八个方向，白色站点，黑边换乘胶囊，水是一条平涂蓝带。

ukiyoe.en: Edo-period woodblock prints come alive: flat colour, carved ink lines, bokashi skies, tactile paper, and a camera that glides like an unrolling handscroll.
ukiyoe.zh: 动起来的江户木版画：平涂色块、刻出的墨线、晕染的天空和纸纹，镜头像展开手卷一样移动。

urban-sketch.en: A sketchbook page drawn on location: fine sepia fineliner lines that wobble, overshoot and never quite close, with loose transparent watercolour dropped on top.
urban-sketch.zh: 现场写生的速写本一页：棕褐针管笔线条发抖、出头、总合不拢，上面随手点染透明水彩。

vintage-collage.en: A magazine collage on a paper table: old engravings, stamps and photos cut out with white margins over torn flat colour, moving like cut-out animation.
vintage-collage.zh: 纸桌上的杂志拼贴：老版画、邮票、旧照片带白边剪下，压在撕开的平涂色纸上，像剪纸动画一样动。

visual-investigation.en: A cold investigation desk: footage, photographs, documents, sound and maps from one real event, laid out on one shared clock so they check each other.
visual-investigation.zh: 一张冷静的调查桌：同一事件的影像、照片、文件、录音和地图排上同一条时间轴，互相印证。

watercolor.en: A hand-painted journal page that paints itself: translucent strokes with dry-brush flying white on warm cotton paper, handwritten notes beside them, no vector lines.
watercolor.zh: 一页自己画出来的手绘笔记：暖色棉纸上半透明的笔触带着飞白，旁边是手写注释，没有矢量线。

white-model.en: A pure white massing model of a real place stands in a dark room, and a projector paints data onto it as light, one layer at a time.
white-model.zh: 暗室里摆着一座真实地点的纯白体块模型，投影机把数据当作光，一层一层刷上去。

whiteboard.en: An explainer drawn live on one glossy whiteboard: handwriting written stroke by stroke, markers with no hand, movable magnets, and a camera that travels instead of cutting.
whiteboard.zh: 在一块光面白板上现场画的讲解：字一笔一笔写出来，不见拿笔的手，镜头在板上走而不切。

woodcut.en: A relief print that carves itself: every frame is a black wood block, and light only exists where a knife has cut it away.
woodcut.zh: 自己刻出来的凸版画：每一帧都是一块黑木版，只有刀刻掉的地方才有光。
